source.title: Showdown at Un'Goro Crater
source.description: It's time at last. It's taken everything out of me to find Van Amburgh's camp here, and I was wounded by one of his traps. His beasts are with him. Are you ready to finish this?
source.objective: Travel to the camp of Van Amburgh in Un'Goro crater, in the south of Kalimdor, and defeat the dwarf and his menagerie.
source.completion: It's done. Van Amburgh will commit no further atrocities.
